case_study.name: Hurricane Helene
case_study.note: A standalone historical replay, not part of the live trip flow. Rainfall is ERA5 reanalysis retrieved after the fact; a traveler would not have had it at departure. Uses the same scoring rule as a live trip.

comparison.message: The routes show similar indicated concern (within 5 points), so this index does not favor one.
comparison.severe_advice: None of the routes avoid the warnings or heavy rain. Check official guidance and road closures, or consider delaying.

alerts.source: NWS VTEC archive (Iowa Environmental Mesonet), Hurricane Helene case study

forecast.source: Open-Meteo archive API, era5_seamless reanalysis (Hurricane Helene case study; historical, not a live forecast)

limitations: Prototype rule, not a calibrated flood probability or a validated score.
Forecasts are uncertain and can be wrong.
The index does not know road closures, drainage, or terrain.
No official alert seen does not mean none exists; alerts issued later are not seen.
